title: BAFU 2026 v1 elementary flows → EF 3.1 characterization flow keys, inferred via Eaternity's biosphere3 pair family
description: Second bafu-2026-v1 → ef-3.1 bridge, ranked below rank 3 so rank 3 wins wherever both map a flow; by construction this payload only holds flows rank 3 lacks. Derived by sentier-importers (sources/eaternity) from the rank-4 ecoinvent-biosphere3 → eaternity-bafu-ext bridge: each Eaternity target is placed at BAFU sub-compartment level through the biosphere3 sub-compartment retained on the rank-4 entry (strict, never a fallback), and its biosphere3 partner is resolved to the EF flow carrying the identical characterization-factor vector in the same compartment (the de-bridging argument of rank 3). Entries carry a comment only as a caveat: a superset twin (the EF flow is characterised in more impact categories) or a twin outside the matching EF sub-compartment. inference_review.json is a non-normative sidecar listing every withheld pair with its reason (Eaternity targets outside the BAFU-2026 v1 universe, biosphere3 partners without an EF 3.1 factor, no CF-compatible EF flow, superset candidates that disagree). Regenerate: python -m sentier_importers run eaternity-inferred-bafu-ef-biosphere (and eaternity-inferred-bafu-ef-review) --deliver-local ~/dds/sentier-mappings, with a fresh --cache-dir.
